title: Taraxerol targets the HIF1A-NEK6 axis to block TDE-mediated M2 macrophage polarization and inhibits NSCLC progression.
authors: Yang, Qiang; Li, Hongli; Guo, Baojun; Gao, Ranran
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物Taraxerol通过HIF1A-NEK6轴调控肿瘤外泌体介导的巨噬细胞M2极化，虽含分子对接/MD模拟和ChIP验证HIF1A-DNA结合，但核心是肿瘤微环境与药物机制，非TF-DNA互作建模或AI方法，仅部分相关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) progression is tightly linked to tumor microenvironment (TME) remodeling. Taraxerol, a natural compound, has shown potential antitumor activity, but its molecular mechanisms in regulating NSCLC, particularly in TME-related progression, remain poorly characterized. METHODS: Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) was conducted to characterize cellular heterogeneity. Network pharmacology integrated differential gene analysis and taraxerol target prediction to identify key regulatory nodes. Molecular interactions were verified via molecular docking and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. CCK-8, EdU, flow cytometry, and Transwell were employed to assess cell proliferation, apoptosis, migration, and invasion. Xenograft models were established to elucidate taraxerol's function in vivo. Subsequently, tumor-derived exosomes (TDEs) were isolated and characterized by transmission electron microscopy (TEM), nanoparticle tracking analysis (NTA), and Western blot. Macrophage characteristics were validated via qRT-PCR. The interaction between hypoxia-inducible factor 1 alpha subunit (HIF1A) and NIMA-related kinase 6 (NEK6) was investigated via chromatin immunoprecipitation (ChIP) and dual-luciferase reporter assays. RESULTS: scRNA-seq revealed NSCLC-specific cellular remodeling, with distinct heterogeneity in macrophage subsets and altered proportions of tumor epithelial cells. HIF1A was a core target of taraxerol, confirmed by molecular docking (binding affinity -8.5 kcal/mol) and MD simulations showing stable interactions. Taraxerol inhibited HIF1A expression in A549/H1299 cells, suppressing proliferation, migration, invasion, and in vivo NSCLC tumorigenesis while promoting apoptosis. Taraxerol-treated TDEs reduced M2 polarization and migration of macrophages, while HIF1A overexpression restored these effects. Furthermore, HIF1A transcriptionally activated NEK6 by directly binding to its promoter, whereas taraxerol blocked the HIF1A-NEK6 axis-mediated promotion of macrophage M2 polarization and migration. CONCLUSION: Taraxerol exerted antitumor effects in NSCLC by targeting HIF1A, thereby regulating TDE-mediated macrophage M2 polarization and tumor progression via the HIF1A-NEK6 axis.
abstract_zh: 背景：非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）的进展与肿瘤微环境（TME）重塑密切相关。Taraxerol作为一种天然化合物，已显示出潜在的抗肿瘤活性，但其在调控NSCLC，尤其是TME相关进展中的分子机制仍鲜有表征。方法：进行单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）以表征细胞异质性。网络药理学整合差异基因分析和taraxerol靶点预测，以识别关键调控节点。通过分子对接和分子动力学（MD）模拟验证分子相互作用。采用CCK-8、EdU、流式细胞术和Transwell评估细胞增殖、凋亡、迁移和侵袭。建立异种移植模型以阐明taraxerol在体内的功能。随后，分离肿瘤来源外泌体（TDEs），并通过透射电子显微镜（TEM）、纳米颗粒追踪分析（NTA）和Western blot进行表征。通过qRT-PCR验证巨噬细胞特征。通过染色质免疫沉淀（ChIP）和双荧光素酶报告基因实验研究缺氧诱导因子1α亚基（HIF1A）与NIMA相关激酶6（NEK6）之间的相互作用。结果：scRNA-seq揭示了NSCLC特异性的细胞重塑，巨噬细胞亚群表现出明显异质性，肿瘤上皮细胞比例发生改变。HIF1A是taraxerol的核心靶点，通过分子对接（结合亲和力-8.5 kcal/mol）和MD模拟显示稳定相互作用得到确认。Taraxerol抑制A549/H1299细胞中HIF1A表达，抑制增殖、迁移、侵袭和体内NSCLC肿瘤发生，同时促进凋亡。Taraxerol处理的TDEs减少巨噬细胞的M2极化和迁移，而HIF1A过表达恢复了这些效应。此外，HIF1A通过直接结合其启动子转录激活NEK6，而taraxerol阻断HIF1A-NEK6轴介导的巨噬细胞M2极化和迁移促进。结论：Taraxerol通过靶向HIF1A在NSCLC中发挥抗肿瘤效应，从而通过HIF1A-NEK6轴调控TDE介导的巨噬细胞M2极化和肿瘤进展。
